name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-05-25, at wavelengths from 1.75 to 4.84 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
